name: foundry-imagegen
description: Generate and edit images with a GPT-image model deployed on Microsoft Foundry, with an in-chat gallery.
long_description: Gives Claude image generation and editing through your own Microsoft Foundry deployment of a GPT-image model (such as gpt-image-2.5-flare). Supports reference images, masks, sizes up to 4K, quality levels, transparent backgrounds, and multiple variations per request. Requests are queued to respect the deployment's requests-per-minute quota. Images are saved to a folder you choose and shown in a gallery with download buttons. Pair it with the foundry-imagegen plugin for the `imagine` prompting skill.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate images from a text prompt.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Edit an image or compose from reference images, optionally with a mask.

tools.name: check_config
tools.description: Check the endpoint, key, deployments, and rate-limit state.

endpoint.title: Foundry endpoint
endpoint.description: Your Foundry / Azure OpenAI resource URL, e.g. https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Key for the Foundry resource (Keys and Endpoint in the portal).

deployment.title: Default deployment
deployment.description: Name of the image model deployment to use by default.

extra_deployments.title: Additional deployments
extra_deployments.description: Optional comma-separated list of other image deployments on the same resource, e.g. gpt-image-2.5-sunburst.

rpm_limit.title: Requests per minute
rpm_limit.description: The deployment's request quota. gpt-image-2.5 GlobalStandard deployments allow 5.

max_wait_seconds.title: Max queue wait (seconds)
max_wait_seconds.description: How long a request may wait for a rate-limit slot before giving up with a retry time.

api_version.title: Legacy API version
api_version.description: api-version for the deployment-scoped route, used only if the resource does not serve the v1 API.
